reasons.title: The name uses letters from another alphabet
reasons.instruction: A file's name becomes its address on the site, and the site writes its addresses in one alphabet. Retype the letters named below in Drive, or rename the file.

reasons.title: Google cannot export the document: it is over 10 MB
reasons.instruction: Google refuses to export a document larger than 10 MB, and large images are the usual cause. Compress or crop the images, or split the document in two.

reasons.title: Downloading is turned off for the file
reasons.instruction: The owner turned off downloading, printing and copying for viewers, so the sync cannot read the file. Turn it back on under Share → Settings, or ask the owner to.

reasons.title: The document holds something the site will not publish
reasons.instruction: Conversion stopped on content it cannot publish safely, named under the document. Remove or replace that part of the document.

reasons.title: Search cannot read the PDF
reasons.action: Replace with a PDF with text
reasons.instruction: The PDF is on the site, but it has no text the site can read: most likely scanned pages, or a password. Search does not find what it says. Replace it with a PDF that has text: most scanning and PDF tools can recognize it (OCR).

reasons.title: The PDF is too large for the site to serve
reasons.instruction: The site serves files up to 25 MB, so the page shows the text of the PDF and links to it in Drive. To put the file itself on the site, save a smaller copy, with images at a lower resolution, and replace this one.

reasons.title: The PDF is too large to read
reasons.instruction: The site does not download a PDF over 100 MB, so its page only links to Drive and search does not find its text. Save a smaller copy and replace this one.

reasons.title: Word and text files
reasons.instruction: The site publishes Google Docs, not Word files. Open each one in Drive, choose File → Save as Google Docs, check the result and delete the original. The new document is published on the next sync.

reasons.title: Presentations
reasons.instruction: The site publishes PDF files. Download the presentation as a PDF, upload it to the same folder, and move the original out of the published folders.

reasons.title: Archives
reasons.instruction: The site does not open archives. Unpack it and upload what it holds: Google Docs and PDF files are published, and anything else is listed here with its own advice. Then delete the archive.

reasons.title: Images
reasons.instruction: An image on its own has no page to show it. Insert it into the Google Doc it belongs to, then move the file out of the published folders.

reasons.title: Diagrams
reasons.instruction: The site cannot draw diagram files. Export the diagram as a PDF, or as an image inserted into the document it explains.

reasons.title: Spreadsheets
reasons.instruction: The site does not publish spreadsheets. Link to each one from the document that explains it, or paste a small table into that document. Move the ones nobody needs out of the published folders.

reasons.title: Video and audio
reasons.instruction: The site does not host video or audio. Link to each file from a document, for example one page that lists the video instructions of a section and says what each one shows.

reasons.title: Other files the site does not publish
reasons.instruction: The site publishes Google Docs and PDF files. If this content belongs on the site, save it as one of those. Otherwise link to it from a document, or move it out of the published folders.

reasons.title: Shortcuts
reasons.instruction: A shortcut points to a file kept somewhere else, and the sync does not follow it. Move the original into this folder, or link to it from a document instead.

noteKinds.title: A cropped image is shown whole
noteKinds.instruction: The image is cropped in Google Docs in a way the site cannot repeat: it is not a PNG, it is also rotated, or its frame cannot be read. So the site shows it as it was inserted, the part cropped away included, to readers and to AI agents. Check that nothing in that part should stay out of the documentation. To show only what you kept, crop the image before inserting it, or insert it as a PNG.

noteKinds.title: Files in one folder share a name
noteKinds.instruction: Readers see two pages called the same, and the second has an address with a code on the end. If both belong on the site, rename one so they can be told apart; if one is a copy, such as a PDF exported from the document, move it out of the published folders.

noteKinds.title: An image was left out
noteKinds.instruction: The export of the document named an image the sync could not find, so the page shows the text without it. Insert the image again in Google Docs.

noteKinds.title: A link was removed
noteKinds.instruction: A link pointed to an address the site does not publish, such as a local file or a script, so its text is on the page without the link. Point it to a web page, a Google Drive file or an email address.

noteKinds.title: A link to a heading opens the top of the page
noteKinds.instruction: A link pointed to a heading inside another document. The site links to that document, but not to the heading, so a reader lands at the top of the page.

noteKinds.title: A link leads to a Google file that is not on this site
noteKinds.action: Publish the file, or link a page
noteKinds.instruction: A link points to a Google Doc or a Drive file outside the published folders. A colleague with access in Drive can open it, but the site cannot show it, and an AI agent reading the site cannot follow it. If the file belongs in the documentation, move it into the published folders; otherwise link to a page of this site where one covers it. Links to spreadsheets, slides and folders are not counted, because the site does not publish them, and neither are links whose address does not say what the file is.

noteKinds.title: A merged table cell was split
noteKinds.instruction: A merged cell in a table spanned a number of rows or columns the site cannot read, so it is shown unmerged. Check that the table still reads right, and merge the cells again in Google Docs if not.

noteKinds.title: Formatting the site does not show was removed
noteKinds.instruction: The document held elements the site does not publish, such as an embedded frame, and they were left out. Check the page, and replace what is missing with a link.

noteKinds.title: A code block is never closed
noteKinds.instruction: A line of three backticks opens a code block and no second one closes it, so everything after it shows as code. Add a line of three backticks where the code ends.

noteKinds.title: Only part of the PDF is searchable
noteKinds.instruction: The PDF holds more text than the site indexes, a million characters, so search finds only its first part. The file itself is complete. Split it if all of it should be found.

noteKinds.title: An image has no description
noteKinds.instruction: The image has no alt text, so people using a screen reader, and AI agents reading the page as text, learn nothing of what it shows. In Google Docs, right-click the image, choose Alt text, and describe it in a sentence.

noteKinds.title: An image is larger than this site expects
noteKinds.instruction: The image file is larger than the size this site notes, so it is slow to open, and an AI agent may be refused it: some AI services take images of a few megabytes at most. Insert a smaller one: a screenshot cropped to what matters before it is inserted, or a photo as JPEG.

noteKinds.title: The page has no summary
noteKinds.instruction: The site takes a page's summary from its first paragraph of plain text. This document has none, only headings, lists or tables, so search results, the section page and the index AI agents read show its title alone. Add a sentence under the title that says what the document is for.

noteKinds.title: Two items share an order number
noteKinds.instruction: Two items in a folder start with the same number, so their order on the site falls back to their names. Give each its own number in Drive.

noteKinds.title: A folder has more than one landing document
noteKinds.instruction: A folder may hold one document named like its landing page, such as Overview, which the site shows first. This one is another; rename it so the folder opens where it should.

noteKinds.title: A number in the name is not read as an order
noteKinds.instruction: The name starts with a number, but not in a form the site reads as an order, so the number shows in the title. Write it as "01 - Name" or "[1] Name", or remove it.

noteKinds.title: A folder the configuration ignores is not there
noteKinds.instruction: The site is configured to leave out a folder that is no longer in the published folders. Ask whoever maintains the site to remove it from GOOGLE_IGNORED_FOLDER_IDS.
